WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT
    e.equipregistry AS equipment_reference,
    AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity
  FROM equipment AS e
  LEFT JOIN scanenvironment AS se
    ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry
  GROUP BY e.equipregistry
),
reference_averages AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(avg_humidity) AS all_equipment_avg
  FROM equipment_averages
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT
    ea.equipment_reference,
    ea.avg_humidity,
    ea.avg_humidity - ra.all_equipment_avg AS excess_over_all_avg
  FROM equipment_averages AS ea
  CROSS JOIN reference_averages AS ra
  WHERE ra.all_equipment_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity > ra.all_equipment_avg
),
group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS above_group_mean
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT
  aa.equipment_reference,
  aa.avg_humidity,
  aa.excess_over_all_avg,
  aa.avg_humidity - gm.above_group_mean AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM above_average AS aa
CROSS JOIN group_mean AS gm
WHERE gm.above_group_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
